5 Ingredient Coconut Treat Squares
By: Aleena Grace
Published: Sunday, March 19, 2017 - 8:14pm

Ingredients




1 Cup Coconut Milk Sweetened Condensed Milk
3 Eggs
1 Cup Canned Unsweetened Coconut Milk
1/3 Cup Gentle Sweet (or the equivalent of your favorite powdered sweetener)
2 Cups Shredded Unsweetened Coconut

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 350. 2 In a mixing bowl, combine condensed milk, eggs, and sweetener and mix well. 3 Add coconut milk and shredded coconut and mix again. 4 Pour into an 8x8 glass pan. 5 Bake for 30-45 minutes, or until top is golden brown and center is no longer jiggly.

About

Sweet and gooey, these delicious coconut treat squares are the perfect accompaniment to a good cup of coffee.
